title: Golden Compass: SLI orchestration and multi-region failover simulator
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Build a consolidated telemetry + visualization pipeline named 'Golden Compass' that unifies token-level latency SLIs, admission/circuit state, and a deterministic failover simulator. Deliverables: 1) ingestion schema updates to include per-token path tags and regional admit_score; 2) Grafana dashboard panels (compass-style) showing admit heatmap, per-prefix token p50/p95/p99, circuit state timeline, and simulated multi-region reroute outcomes; 3) a lightweight failover simulator harness that replays synthetic traffic to validate circuit thresholds and load-shed policies before rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Ingestion schema updated and backwards-compatible to include 'token_path', 'prefix_cohort', 'admit_score', 'kv_hit', and 'region' tags
Dashboard with at least 6 panels: global overview, per-region p50/p95/p99 token latency, admit_score heatmap, circuit-state timeline, failover-sim results table, and candidate policy impact estimator
Failover simulator can run deterministic scenarios and produce replayed metric traces that match real pipeline shape within 10% error
Runbook drafted with playbook steps for detection, rollback, and emergency manual shed policy
No >5% increase in ingestion cost for standard sampling rate (default sample 1/20); provide config to disable for sensitive tenants
updates: 2026-02-20 - Ticket created by Diego Ramos: scoped Golden Compass initiative; initial sketch attached in links
2026-02-22 - Architect sync: decided to extend current telemetry proto rather than create parallel pipeline to avoid duplication; agreed on fields and tag cardinality limits
2026-02-25 - Design review (Aisha): advised adding prefix_cohort to reduce cardinality and support PLG tenants versus enterprise cohorts
2026-03-01 - ENG feedback (Kenji Mori): recommended eBPF micro-span collector for precise token timing on ingress path; flagged potential Ops impact for high-throughput routes
2026-03-04 - Demo: initial dashboard wireframe in Grafana with admit_score heatmap and region selector. UX feedback: need clearer legend for circuit colors and time-travel slider

2026-03-07 - Instrumentation PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412 - adds token_path and admit_score tags with sample-rate config. Added KV hit boolean and quantized sequence_length bucket

2026-03-10 - Failover-sim prototype: replay harness can replay synthetic 10k requests and produce simulated regional reroute. Observed a 12% mismatch on p99 tail during cold-start; added KV warmup pre-run hook as mitigation and lowered mismatch to 7%
notes: Implementation trade-offs discussed: full-cardinality token_path increases cardinality; we mitigate via prefix_cohort and k-limit per tenant. Default sample rate 1/20 for token_path events; critical tenants can opt into full sampling.
Simulator design: deterministic input seed + KV-warmup stage + admission-policy toggles so SREs can validate policy changes before live rollout.
Dashboard UX: propose 'compass' overview (north=latency tails, east=admit pressure, south=circuit state, west=failover risk). Time-travel scrubber and per-tenant toggle required for troubleshooting.
Operational concern: eBPF collector needs canary in staging with traffic shaping; add an opt-out flag for air-gapped Private customers.
